meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 技能装上后，Atomic Chat 桌面应用里的本地模型会变成两个可调用的工具：一个列出可用模型，另一个把问题发给指定模型并返回回答；Claude 仍负责调度。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 Atomic Chat 本地模型、添加 MCP 服务器或让容器代理能调用这些模型时触发，随后按清单改代码并重启服务。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里？
用 atomic_chat_list_models 列出当前可用的本地模型。
say.note: 只查询模型列表，不做生成。

howto.what_en: After installation, local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app are exposed as two callable tools: list available models, and send a prompt to a chosen model to get its answer. Claude remains the orchestrator.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to integrate Atomic Chat local models, add an MCP server, or let the container agent call those models; it then applies the listed code changes and restarts the service.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude will list Atomic Chat models first, then pick one to answer.

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_list_models to list the available local models.
say_en.note: Only lists models; no generation happens.

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_generate to have qwen2.5-coder-7b explain recursion.
say_en.note: The prompt is sent to that model and the answer is returned.
